TakenOver.description: Where a journal came from, when it did not start in `raul`.

from.description: What it was taken over from: `nvmod-setup`.

version.description: The version of the program that wrote the old state, as that state names it.

description: The document in the journal file (Contract `raul-journal`, version 1).

complete.description: Whether every step of the plan finished.

finished.description: The ids of the steps that finished, in the order they finished.

plan.description: The ids of the steps of the setup, in order, as the plan named them when the run began (see `Step::id`).

raul_version.description: The version of `raul` that last wrote the file.

request.description:
The setup request the run was started with, as `raul-core` writes it (its `done` list left out), so a
resume needs the Instance and nothing else. `null` until a run has started, and when an `nvmod setup` state
was taken over whose command line could not be read.

taken_over.description: Set when the journal was made from an unfinished `nvmod setup` and not by `raul` itself.

title: JournalDoc
